description:
Mun Yegyeol, once a disciple of Kunlun, died protecting the senior brother he had secretly adored. But he reincarnated in 21st-century Korea as an esper. One day, while traveling with his parents, he was attacked by an anti-esper organization and lost control, going berserk. When he opened his eyes again… he had awakened back in the Central Plains? And the mysterious guide who saved him turned out to be none other than his senior brother from his past life—Je Ha-ryang? 

To think I’d find my destined guide here in the Central Plains when I couldn’t find them in Korea. If my senior brother insists on treating me as nothing more than a weak, naive junior, I’ll just stick to him like glue and tangle myself up in his life!

Mun Yegyeol clings to his senior with exaggerated coyness—But… is his senior hiding something from him?
